changeSet.author: Kiran Kumar
changeSet.comment: Create the default basic billing plan
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO billing.plan (code, display_name, is_active) VALUES ('basic', 'Basic', true) ON CONFLICT (code) DO UPDATE SET display_name = EXCLUDED.display_name, is_active = EXCLUDED.is_active, updated_at = now();

changeSet.author: Kiran Kumar
changeSet.comment: Seed default limits for the basic plan
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO billing.plan_limit (plan_id, metric_key, limit_value, limit_unit, enforcement_mode) SELECT p.id, seeded.metric_key, seeded.limit_value, seeded.limit_unit, seeded.enforcement_mode FROM billing.plan p JOIN ( VALUES ('storage.bytes.total', 2147483648::BIGINT, 'bytes', 'hard_block'), ('collaborators.count.per_space', 5::BIGINT, 'count', 'hard_block') ) AS seeded(metric_key, limit_value, limit_unit, enforcement_mode) ON true WHERE p.code = 'basic' ON CONFLICT (plan_id, metric_key) DO UPDATE SET limit_value = EXCLUDED.limit_value, limit_unit = EXCLUDED.limit_unit, enforcement_mode = EXCLUDED.enforcement_mode, updated_at = now();

changeSet.author: Kiran Kumar
changeSet.comment: Assign the basic plan to existing billing accounts that have no active subscription
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO billing.account_subscription (account_id, plan_id, status, effective_from, source) SELECT a.id, p.id, 'active', now(), 'system_default_basic' FROM billing.account a JOIN billing.plan p ON p.code = 'basic' WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM billing.account_subscription s WHERE s.account_id = a.id AND (s.effective_to IS NULL OR s.effective_to > now()) AND lower(s.status) IN ('active', 'trialing', 'grace_period') );

changeSet.author: Kiran Kumar
changeSet.comment: Automatically attach the basic plan to newly created billing accounts
